recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-31359 unless a future Schedule example introduces serviceCategory, serviceType, or specialty codings without systems.
issue_request: FHIR-31359 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking that Schedule examples, including schedule-example.json, add Coding.system values for serviceCategory, serviceType, and specialty codings.
initial_application: The request was applied by e9ca994112d3f9de789ddb7abe8052a55507f869 on 2022-08-09, which added service-category, service-type, and SNOMED CT system values to the three then-existing Schedule example XML sources. The later HealthcareService Schedule example added by 94d08fad8754ebd38f054a24a6e46158b7daeee5 already included systems on its coded fields.
additional_context: Schedule is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. PA January 2022 WGM minutes record the same Schedule/Coding.system request and an 8-0-0 persuasive vote. Zulip searches found only unrelated hits and no conflicting implementation guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the authoritative Schedule example XML files already contain the requested system values.
